Narrated zone lore for **[Spoken](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/spoken)**'s Places module, and narrated boss stories for its Bosses module. This addon is data only — it does nothing on its own.

The CurseForge download holds two folders: `SpokenPlacesAudio`, the zone and subzone lore, and `SpokenBossesAudio`, the boss stories. Boss stories need Spoken 3.7.0 or later.

## The voice, as of 0.3.0

Every line was re-recorded with a new narrator — picked for the tone the lore deserves rather than for getting a first pass made cheaply — and the names of NPCs and places now go through a pronunciation dictionary, so Lordaeron sounds the same in every line it appears in.

That doesn't make it finished. With this many lines, some readings will still land flat and some names will still come out wrong. If a line reads badly, report it: the Report button beside a playing story opens that line on [spoken.rusty.one](https://spoken.rusty.one), and per-line re-rolls follow what comes in.

The **lore text** was rewritten in the same release to describe the world as a vanilla character finds it. Where a line's text gets fixed, its narration is regenerated — so an occasional re-download is expected.

## Installing

Install **Spoken** first; this pack is inert without it. Extract every folder in the download into `Interface/AddOns` and leave the folder names as shipped — Spoken finds packs by folder name.

## Compatibility

For **WoW Forever**, Classic Era and Anniversary, with Spoken 3.0.0 or later.

## Support

Every one of these lines — and there are a lot of them — costs money to synthesise, and every reported fix costs it again. If the narration is worth something to you, [buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/rustykey) — it's what funds the fixes.
